name: Vitreous-Bastion
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past an ancient meteor crater, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
